name: Angling Table and Tackle
description: Fit lines, hooks and bobbers to a rod.

pages.title: Angling Table and Tackle
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- The **Angling Table** fits a line, a hook and a bobber to any Tide rod.
- **Lines** make the timing game easier.
- **Hooks** change what bites, or let you fish lava and the void.
- **Bobbers** are just for looks.

pages.title: Angling Table
pages.text: 2 string, 2 copper ingots, 2 planks. Put a rod in, add tackle, take the upgraded rod out. Putting a fitted rod back in returns its tackle.

**Lines** (two ingots or gems with a Fishing Line between):

- **Copper**: marker 10%% slower.
- **Golden**: marker 5%% slower and +1 luck.
- **Iron**: fish 15%% easier to land.
- **Diamond**: fish 25%% easier to land.

A Fishing Line (3 string in a column) does nothing by itself.

**Tide hooks:**

- **Fiery** (blaze rod): water counts as warmer, so warm-water fish bite.
- **Permafrost** (blue ice): water counts as colder.
- **Twilight** (clock): fish act as if it were 12 hours later, so night fish bite by day.

- **Lavaproof** (gold and obsidian): fish in lava with any rod.
- **Hook of the Depths** (crying obsidian, dragon's breath): fish in the void.\
\
See [#](2E5AAC)[Lava and Void Fishing](entry://fishing/lava_and_void)[#]().

**Hybrid Aquatic hooks** also fit:

- **Barbed**: bites come sooner by day.
- **Glowing**: bites come sooner at night.
- **Magnetic**: +1 luck.
- **CreeperMagnet**: the next catch is a creeper instead. Breaks after one use.

- **Ominous** (9 different crab claws): the next catch pulls up **Karkinos**, Hybrid Aquatic's giant crab boss, instead of a fish. Breaks after one use.\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** Karkinos lands at your feet. Fish from somewhere you can fight.

**Bobbers** change only the look of your float: 16 dye colours, apples, ingots, gems, a duck and more. Each is a slime ball, a plank and the item, crafted together.\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Aquaculture hooks, lines and bobbers don't fit Tide rods.
